endcard: Save this for when every way looks shut

save.tr: “No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.”

lines.say: The sea in front of you. The enemy behind you. Where do you run?
Pharaoh's army reached them at sunrise.
Musa's companions cried: Indeed, we are to be overtaken!
Moses said: No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.
lines.cap: “No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.”

lines.say: Then Allah inspired him: Strike with your staff the sea. And it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
lines.cap: “…and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: Allah had commanded him to bring them there, and Allah does not go back on His promise.
lines.cap: Allah commanded him to bring them there, and He does not go back on His promise.

lines.say: And Allah saved them, all together.
When every way looks shut, say it with certainty: my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
Save this, and send it to someone who feels trapped today.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone who feels trapped today 🤍

v1.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
v1.tr: “And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, ‘Indeed, we are to be overtaken!’”

v2.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
v2.tr: “[Moses] said, ‘No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.’”

v3.ar:
فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب
بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ
فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
v3.tr: “Then We inspired to Moses, ‘Strike with your staff the sea,’ and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.”
